title: Hospital appointment booking intermittently returns 500s
description: Reception staff report the booking system 'randomly' fails maybe one in ten times since Monday. Refreshing usually works. No pattern anyone can see. It has not been escalated because there is a workaround, but a patient booking was lost on Wednesday and now it is a formal incident.

deployment_notes:
booking-api: last deployed 2024-10-21 (v3.8.2). No changes since.

Other infrastructure changes:
  2024-10-28  Identity provider rotated its signing keys (scheduled, quarterly).
              Rotation announced by email to the platform mailing list.
  2024-10-28  Network team applied a new egress firewall policy to the api
              subnet. Ticket NET-2201. Allow-list based. Change window 09:00-10:00.
  2024-11-01  api-2 was rebuilt from the base image after a disk failure.
              (api-1, api-3 and api-4 were not rebuilt.)
user_reports:
Reception A (Mon) - "It fails now and then. We just click again and it works."
Reception B (Tue) - "Happens more in the morning I think? Could be busier then."
Reception C (Wed) - "We booked Mrs Cohen and it errored, so we rebooked. She got two confirmation texts."
Reception A (Thu) - "Feels random. Definitely not every time."
IT helpdesk note - "Suspect load related, four nodes may not be enough at peak. Recommend scaling up."
extra:
Request distribution across nodes is round-robin, roughly 25% each.
Observed failure rate: approximately 10% of requests.

JWKS endpoint reachability, tested 2024-11-04 15:00 from each node:
  api-1  curl https://idp.internal/.well-known/jwks.json  -> 200 OK
  api-3  curl https://idp.internal/.well-known/jwks.json  -> 200 OK
  api-4  curl https://idp.internal/.well-known/jwks.json  -> 200 OK
  api-2  curl https://idp.internal/.well-known/jwks.json  -> 403 Forbidden

CPU across all four nodes during the incident window stayed below 35%.
Memory below 50%. No node restarted.
